channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Ingles | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Ingles from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Julius Randle on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Jonah: Julius Randle on Mike Conley and Joe Ingles' veteran leadership:

“I’ve talked all year about the leader that he is (Conley) for our team, and how he kinda keeps us balanced. -- How he or Joe is able to pull me to the side. Keep me level-headed. -- Those guys are huge.”

Julius Randle on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, May 9, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Ricky Rubio, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Mitchell told The Athletic over the weekend.

“When Mike was saying that, it wasn’t that I didn’t appreciate it then, but when you’re as young as I was then, you don’t know what you don’t know. “I find myself telling the guys in this locker room the same stuff that Mike and Joe (Ingles) and Ricky (Rubio) used to tell me. What we have this season? This isn’t always the NBA. Not every locker room is like this.”

Donovan Mitchell on Ricky Rubio, Joe Ingles, Dec 24, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Eric Walden:Mike Budenholzer, on the addition of Joe Ingles:

“From the day he walked through our doors, he's impacted our facility, the spirit, the energy. He's funny, he's hard, he's edgy. He's just somebody you want to have in your program.”

Mike Budenholzer on Joe Ingles, Mar 24, 2023. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on Joe Ingles:

“Today’s a tough day with Joe. I can’t really articulate how much he’s meant to our organization and to me personally.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Feb 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Rudy Gay on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Rudy Gay, on Joe Ingles:

“It’s not even about the basketball; just having him in the locker room is good for us. He’s our guy.”

Rudy Gay on Joe Ingles, Jan 31, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Josh Green on Patty Mills, Joe Ingles
item.description:
“It’s always been a dream of mine as a kid. And also just as far from a development standpoint, just being able to get in games and just feel more comfortable on the court and be around guys like Ben, Joe Ingles Patty Mills and guys like that who have really helped me out and to just grow as a player. I’m really looking forward to it and just looking forward to the offseason in general.”

Josh Green on Patty Mills, Joe Ingles, Jun 18, 2021. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Quin Snyder, on Joe Ingles' play:

“It’s hard in my mind for Joe to take a bad shot, because he’s such a great shooter. … It’s always a little different when he’s a primary ballhandler, but I don’t think there’s a lack of comfort or hesitancy.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Jun 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the role of Joe Ingles:

“Joe played the point for about the last month of the season, and that's a heavy load. I don't think anyone would call Joe a point guard — he is a playmaker. HE's also one of the top catch-and-shoot 3-point shooters in the league.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Jun 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles' versatility:

“I talked to him earlier in the year about being a utility infielder — but first I had to explain to him what baseball was.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, May 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson and Joe Ingles being the two betting favorites for Sixth an of the Year:

“I hope they both compete with each other for Defensive Player of the Year, although I don’t know if Rudy would accept that.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Apr 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Georges Niang on John Stockton, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Georges Niang on the possibility of Joe Ingles passing John Stockton's Jazz 3PM record tonight:

“I say we don't pass him the ball. John Stockton's a legend.”

Georges Niang on John Stockton, Joe Ingles, Jan 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Mills says, before repeating himself.

“I don't say that necessarily as a good thing. We definitely have got some work to do in this area, I believe, but for now it's full focus on Tokyo,and a gold medal would do wonders for our program, as at least a starting point. There's a prestigious feeling within our program that needs to be a joint effort between the playing group and Basketball Australia to make sure when -- we've lost 'Bogues' [Andrew Bogut], obviously -- I step away, when Joe Ingles steps away, 'Delly' [Matthew Dellavedova], [Aron] Baynes -- that that program is still elite, if not even more levels up, as it should be.”

Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova, Jan 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles:

“He’d be playing tonight if he could. ... It makes you pause for a second and reflect on a streak like that and what kind of teammate Joe is.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Jan 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Georges Niang, Tony Bradley
item.description:
“I was really excited about the chemistry that we were getting with our second unit that Quin had found with Mike Conley, Jordan Clarkson, Joe Ingles, Georges Niang and Tony Bradley,”

Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Georges Niang, Tony Bradley, May 8, 2020. Source: deseret.com.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Pistons coachDwane Casey on Joe Ingles:

“He looks like he's slow, can't move, and has a bartender-type look. But he's a legit star in our league.”

Dwane Casey on Joe Ingles, Dec 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Quin Snyder, on Ingles’ move to the bench:

“Maybe I’m undervaluing it. I want Joe to play well all game. There’s times where he gets an opportunity to make plays that he wouldn’t necessarily get if he were starting. ... He takes pride in how he plays no matter when he’s playing.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Nov 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
“So, I have encouraged him to wear one.... Joe Ingles also thinks he shot better with one last year, so he asked me if he could wear one ... if that’s the case I might wear one too!”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Sep 9, 2019. Source: deseret.com.

item.title: Steven Adams on New Zealand, Joe Ingles
item.description:
If you thought the trans-Tasman rivalry was off-limits during the NBA season, you would be sorely mistaken, as verbal barbs between the Australian contingent and Adams continue across the Pacific.

“Oh yeah, they chime in bro, they chime in because we'll check out the NBL because we have the New Zealand Breakers so [Joe] Ingles will chirp up and say, 'hey you see the score mate?'and it's like, 'yeah, carry on with the game, w-----,'”

Steven Adams on New Zealand, Joe Ingles, Apr 12, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Kyle Korver, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Jazz general manager Dennis Lindsey joked that Joe Ingles — who boldly declared himself as the league’s top shooter during the preseason — is no longer the best marksman on the roster.

“I’ve been greatly offended by Joe Ingles’ claim to be the greatest shooter on the planet. and as a proud American, that is comparing himself to Steph Curry and Klay Thompson and Kyle Korver, I was offended,”

Dennis Lindsey on Kyle Korver, Joe Ingles, Dec 4, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Eric Woodyard:Warriors Star Steph Curry on Jazzman Joe Ingles calling himself the best shooter in the league:

“That just means in Las Vegas in summer league in 2009 we had 2 of the best shooters of all time on the same team... we got a lot in common.”

Stephen Curry on Joe Ingles, Oct 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles:

“We didn't want to put a ceiling on him. He couldn't touch it if he did.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, May 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Johnnie Bryant, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Hayward on his dinner with Ingles last night:

“It was just like old times, dinner with Joe and Johnnie Bryant. Talked a little bit about basketball, talked a lot about life. They'll be friends of mine for as long as time.”

Gordon Hayward on Johnnie Bryant, Joe Ingles, Dec 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Draymond Green on Joe Ingles
item.description:
In postgame interviewDraymond Green told me:

“Ingles told media they were hoping we'd come in unbeaten. Gotta be careful what you wish for.”

Draymond Green on Joe Ingles, Dec 1, 2015. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Dante Exum on Joe Ingles
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Dante Exum on mate Joe Ingles' free agency:

“I’m rooting for it (Utah return). I know Joe loved it here. I would love to have him back.”

Dante Exum on Joe Ingles, Jul 3, 2015. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.
